From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Ross <emily.ross@heliomed.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Engagement roadmap — first draft (GDoc + Slides)

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our discussion I pulled together a concise engagement roadmap (GDoc) and a small slide stub that outlines a recommended 30-day pilot and the acceptance milestones we discussed. Quick summary below, full doc attached:

Proposed (high-level) timeline
- Week0 (day 0–7): kickoff, demo integration, test dataset pass
- Week1 (day 8–14): baseline evaluation, latency/cost checks, initial QA
- Week2 (day 15–21): feature validation, user flows, quality gating
- Week4 (day 22–30): acceptance review, handoff to your infra team, wrap

Key asks for HelioMed
- Provide a primary technical contact for API keys and test data
- Confirm regulatory constraints (PHI handling) and any IP boundaries
- Lock a 60–90 minute kickoff window next week for a walkthrough

Links / quick assets (editable)
- Engagement_Roadmap_v0.1.gdoc (view/comment) — full action lanes and owners
- Week0-Kickoff-Slides-v0.1.gslides — 4-slide kickoff agenda and owners

Could you review and let me know: 1) whether the milestones look aligned, and 2) which day you'd prefer for the walkthrough next week (I listed a few windows in the doc)? If the timeline looks tight we can compress to a 21-day pilot — open to your preference.

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on this.

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0129

Attachment: Engagement_Roadmap_v0.1.gdoc (link)
Attachment: Week0-Kickoff-Slides-v0.1.gslides
From: Emily Ross <emily.ross@heliomed.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:03:34 -0700
Subject: Re: Engagement roadmap — first draft (GDoc + Slides)

Hi Hannah —

Thanks — this is helpful and the doc looks clear. A couple notes from our side:

- Ops will want to run a security quick-check before any pilot (I cc'ed ops@heliomed.com).
- Given our internal review windows, a 21-day pilot would be preferable if we can still hit the key evaluation gates (latency, throughput, and accuracy on our sample set).
- Week0 walkthrough: Tue 2026-06-29 10:00–11:00 PT would work for our core team.

I'll take a pass through the GDoc and annotate questions inline. Can you add a short column that captures 'data classification' for each Milestone (PHI / Non-PHI / Synthetic)? That will help speed internal approvals.

Best,
Emily

Director, Product Ops | HelioMed
emily.ross@heliomed.com

Thanks Hannah — looks like a solid starting point. A couple internal notes before we confirm the 21-day option with the customer:

- Tradeoffs: compressing to 21 days means we should tighten acceptance gates to 3 short measurable checks (basic accuracy slice, latency at 95th pct, and a smoke data-run). I'll add those as pass/fail rows.
- Owners: I'll take the baseline evaluation and coordinate test dataset swaps with HelioMed ops. Ben — can you own the performance tuning plan (batching / kv caching recommendations)?
- Security asks: Jasmine, can you confirm what SOC2 artifacts we can share pre-pilot and add a link in the doc? Emily requested data-class columns; we'll add that.

I've attached a compact slide update (Week0-Kickoff-Slides-v0.2.gslides) with the shorter pilot option and a proposed Day 0 checklist. If everyone agrees I'll push the updated slides and a 21d timeline spreadsheet to the shared GDoc by EOD.
